<section class="section section--surface" data-sec data-screen-label="Era of trust" id="era-of-trust">
	<div class="container">
		<div class="feature-scroll" data-feature-scroll>
			<div class="feature-scroll__copy">
				<div class="section-head">
					<span class="eyebrow eyebrow--boxed">Era of trust<i class="eyebrow__corner"></i></span>
					<h2 class="t-h2">Unlock the autonomy of agents, safely</h2>
				</div>
				<div class="feature-scroll__list" role="list">
					<div class="feature-scroll__item" data-fs-item role="listitem" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false">
						<h3 class="feature-scroll__title">Trusted autonomy.</h3>
						<div class="feature-scroll__more"><div>
							<p class="t-body">Autonomy is only possible when agents can be trusted to act alone. Built-in MicroVM isolation, signed components, and runtime policy mean agents can work on their own, and you don’t pay for the cleanup.</p>
							<a class="btn btn--outline" id="dkr_homepage-era-isolation-body-learn-more" href="/products/docker-sandboxes/">Learn more</a>
						</div></div>
						<i class="feature-scroll__progress" aria-hidden="true"></i>
					</div>
					<div class="feature-scroll__item" data-fs-item role="listitem" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false">
						<h3 class="feature-scroll__title">Ship faster. Without the breach.</h3>
						<div class="feature-scroll__more"><div>
							<p class="t-body">Agents move faster when they don’t have to ask permission. Give each sandbox only the MCP servers it needs. Keep your keys on the host, and let it run.</p>
							<a class="btn btn--outline" id="dkr_homepage-era-speed-body-learn-more" href="/products/mcp-enterprise-gateway/">Learn more</a>
						</div></div>
						<i class="feature-scroll__progress" aria-hidden="true"></i>
					</div>
					<div class="feature-scroll__item" data-fs-item role="listitem" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false">
						<h3 class="feature-scroll__title">Compliant by default.</h3>
						<div class="feature-scroll__more"><div>
							<p class="t-body">Start from images that are already clean. Docker Hardened Images arrive with near-zero CVEs, a signed SBOM, and provenance you can verify, so audits don’t turn into scrambles.</p>
							<a class="btn btn--outline" id="dkr_homepage-era-policy-body-learn-more" href="/products/hardened-images/">Learn more</a>
						</div></div>
						<i class="feature-scroll__progress" aria-hidden="true"></i>
					</div>
				</div>
			</div>
			<div class="feature-scroll__cards">
				<figure class="feature-scroll__card era theme-dark" data-fs-card data-nav-ignore data-era="isolation">
